subject: Starbucks Red Cup Day 2026
title: When is Red Cup Day 2026? Tuesday, Nov. 17, at Starbucks
answer: Starbucks Red Cup Day 2026 is Tuesday, Nov. 17. Customers get a free, limited-edition reusable red holiday cup with the purchase of a seasonal beverage. Starbucks' holiday menu, with drinks such as the Peppermint Mocha and Caramel Brulée Latte, has been available since Nov. 5.
body:
Starbucks announced the date in its 2026 holiday lineup. The returning holiday drinks include the Peppermint Mocha, Caramel Brulée Latte, Sugar Cookie Latte and Gingerbread Chai, all on the menu since Nov. 5, 2026.

Red Cup Day falls between two other holiday merchandise drops: a mystery "Surprise Box" collection of glass Bearista cold cups that went on sale Nov. 10, and the original Bearista glass cup, which returns to select coffeehouses on Dec. 1.
in_the_news: Starbucks' free reusable red cup giveaway returns on Nov. 17, 2026.

faq.q: Is Red Cup Day 2026 on Nov. 17?
faq.a: Yes. Starbucks says the tradition returns on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026.

faq.q: How do you get a free red cup at Starbucks?
faq.a: Buy a seasonal beverage on Red Cup Day, and you get a free limited-edition reusable red holiday cup.

faq.q: What drinks count for Red Cup Day?
faq.a: Starbucks says a seasonal beverage, such as the Peppermint Mocha, Caramel Brulée Latte, Sugar Cookie Latte or Gingerbread Chai.

faq.q: When does the Bearista cup come back?
faq.a: Mystery Bearista boxes went on sale Nov. 10, 2026; the original Bearista returns Dec. 1 at select stores.
